name: Mirror Frame
description: Hold the left and right bones in mirrored lines so a blow on one is shared with the other.

name: Counter Rib
description: Strike with the rib on one side the moment the other side takes a hit.

name: Skeleton Sense
description: Compare the user's own two sides to find which bones of a foe stand out of balance.

name: Matched Bones
description: Strike with the left limb and the right in step so each blow opens the guard for the next.

name: Twin Brace
description: Brace both arms against a grip and lock the target's wrists between them.

name: Crossed Limbs
description: Cross the user's limbs over the target's arms and press them flat to the body.

name: Skeleton Rush
description: Rush in with both sides of the frame striking together and break through the guard in one pass.

name: Echo Mirror
description: Hollow the bones on the struck side so the blow rings across to the other and is thrown back.

name: Dual Frame
description: Close both tracks of bone on a foe from either side and crush the frame beneath all guard.

name: Talon Bone
description: Grow a hooked talon of bone from the heel of the hand and rake it across the target.

name: Wing Brace
description: Spread a wing of bone from the shoulder blade to cover the flank and take a blow.

name: Kestrel Sense
description: Hold the head still on the neck like a hovering hawk and mark every motion below.

name: Wingleap
description: Beat the hollow wings once and leap a long pace with the body held light.

name: Hooked Talon
description: Sink a talon into the target's guard arm and hold them to the user's reach.

name: Pinion Gust
description: Beat both wings together and send a hard buffet of air that knocks back foes in front.

name: Raking Talon
description: Rake down the target's arm with a talon and tear the weapon out of its line.

name: Talon Stoop
description: Fold the wings and fall on the target with the talons forward and drive them through the guard.

name: Spread Wings
description: Spread both wings wide to cover a retreat and glide the user a long way back.

name: Raptor Skeleton
description: Flash across the gap in one stoop with the whole frame turned to wing and talon and strike on arrival.

name: Marrow Store
description: Gather marrow qi in the hollow of the long bones until it stands full and calm.

name: Run Strike
description: Let a thin run of stored qi flow down the arm bone and break in the fist.

name: Seep Ward
description: Let marrow qi seep out through the surface of the bone to thicken it against a blow.

name: Marrow Current
description: Pour marrow qi into an ally's injured limb to knit the break and refill the weakened bone.

name: Eddy Bone
description: Spin a small eddy of qi inside the target's limb bone and spoil the grip of their hand.

name: Silt Bone
description: Clog the marrow of the target's legs with heavy qi until they slow and sink.

name: Marrow Spate
description: Break the held basin and let a rush of marrow qi burst outward through the bones of every foe near.

name: Flowing Frame
description: Let the river run through the whole frame to harden it and close small hurts as they come.

name: Marrow Drain
description: Draw the marrow qi out of a foe's long bones in a pull that no armour of flesh can stop.

name: Shell Raise
description: Raise an inner shell of bone round the trunk to take a blow on its hard curve.

name: Shell Knock
description: Knock the shelled shoulder into the target and send them back a step.

name: Shell Turn
description: Roll the shell against a cut so it skids over the curve and away.

name: Shell Sense
description: Feel the knocks on the shell and read the weight and angle of each blow.

name: Tuck Roll
description: Tuck into the shell and roll clear of a sweeping strike to come up on one knee.

name: Paired Shells
description: Grow a second shell over the first so the inner one gathers strength as the outer one takes blows.

name: Shell Slam
description: Slam the full shell into the target and break their balance and their guard together.

name: Shell Lock
description: Close the shell over a grasped limb and hold it fast against the user's side.

name: Double Carapace
description: Set both shells at once into one thick carapace that turns even a heavy weapon's edge.

name: Shell Burst
description: Burst the outer shell in a ring of hard pieces that strikes every foe close about the user.

name: Monarch's Shell
description: Take a crushing blow wholly into the shell and loose its force back through a single palm.

name: Oath Rib
description: Swear the ribs closed upon the oath so a heavy blow to the chest finds no give.

name: Vow Fist
description: Throw a fist whose every bone is sworn to the same line and lands as one piece.

name: Vow Touch
description: Press a palm to a foe and feel which bones of theirs are held in earnest and which are slack.

name: Pledge Lock
description: Speak the vow and lock the target's limb bones to it so they will not bend away.

name: Oath Crack
description: Strike a sworn blow that cracks the bone it lands on and leaves the vow unbroken.

name: Vow Hold
description: Keep the target's frame bent under the oath until they cannot rise to their full height.

name: Sworn Fracture
description: Drive a sworn blow through the guard and break the great bone beneath it.

name: Oath Pillar
description: Stand as a pillar of sworn bone that holds the line against any push or pull.

name: Oath Kept
description: Pay out the whole oath in a single blow that breaks the frame beneath every guard.

name: Spine Bearing
description: Run the sense down the spine and out along the bearing to a distant mark.

name: Long Spur
description: Thrust a spur of bone out past the fist and hit a foe just beyond arm's length.

name: Spine Hold
description: Hold the spine like a tall mast and take a gust or a push down its length.

name: Distant Draw
description: Draw qi out toward the farthest link of the spine and prepare the next cast.

name: Spine Cast
description: Cast a stout bone from the spine in a flat throw that carries across the field.

name: Far Brace
description: Brace the frame against a force that comes from a distance and bleed it into the ground.

name: Taut Brace
description: Stretch the user's spine taut toward the target and pin them with the line of its pull.

name: Spine Javelin
description: Gather a long javelin of fused vertebrae and hurl it across the field at one mark.

name: Bearing Fracture
description: Send the bone straight along the bearing so it breaks through the guard of a distant foe.

name: Farthest Rib
description: Hurl a single rib down the longest bearing and break the frame of a foe at the limit of reach.

name: Bone Leap
description: Hollow the long bones for a moment and bound light and far across the ground.

name: Reed Strike
description: Whip a hollow arm bone like a reed and snap its tip against the target.

name: Drift Ward
description: Let a blow pass through the hollow of the frame and spend itself in the air.

name: Gust Ribcage
description: Spread the hollow ribs and let the wind through them in a sharp blast at the foes ahead.

name: Light Frame
description: Thin the frame to the weight of a reed so the user moves and strikes faster.

name: Airy Sense
description: Let the hollow bones sing in the air currents and read from their pitch where foes stand.

name: Windbone Cut
description: Cut with an edge of hollow bone carried on a hard gust and slice straight through the guard.

name: Updraft Leap
description: Ride a rising gust on the hollow frame and leap far over a foe's head.

name: Weightless Frame
description: Make the whole frame weightless for one breath and cross a wide gap before a foe can turn.

name: Oath Spine
description: Swear the spine upright and let it carry a heavy blow down into the legs.

name: Standing Fist
description: Strike from a planted stance with no step so the blow carries only the frame's weight.

name: Root Feel
description: Send the sense down through the legs into the ground and feel what shifts above it.

name: Brace Draw
description: Draw qi into every brace of the frame until it stands firm for the coming exchange.

name: Rooted Frame
description: Root the stance so deeply that a grappling foe is held fast to the same spot.

name: Keel Press
description: Lean the whole frame on the target like a pillar and hold them where they stand.

name: Sworn Elbow Drive
description: Shove with the sworn frame so the target is pushed out of their stance and off their line.

name: Unshaken Frame
description: Hold the whole frame as one oath of bone that blows and winds alike cannot shift.

name: Standing Break
description: Break the target's stance with a single blow struck from the unmoving frame.

name: Oath Unbroken
description: Take every blow into the sworn frame and let none of it pass to the flesh beneath.
